_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Used ONLY for the spend ceiling. Verify against the provider's pricing page before a large run — a stale rate here makes the budget guard wrong. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing

_unknown_model_fallback._why: Deliberately far above any real rate. An unpriced model therefore OVER-estimates spend and trips the ceiling early, which fails safe. Never lower this as a shortcut — add the real model instead.

cached_input_multiplier._why: Cached/prompt-cache-read input tokens bill at a fraction of the standard input rate.
